approach: Pose-fitted armored body atlases; independently composited weapons.

jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: an exact 1536x1024 sprite atlas containing 12 unarmed swordsmen (4 columns, 3 rows). Image 2 is an ARMOR DESIGN REFERENCE ONLY. Edit ONLY the torso clothing in EACH of the 12 existing character poses to wear the reference armor, naturally fitted to that body's perspective and pose. This is a registered animation atlas: preserve exact canvas size, all original sprite positions, scale, feet, head, copper hair, face, teal scarf, navy sleeves, forearms, gloves, fists and all arm/leg poses. Absolutely no weapons: clenched EMPTY hands must stay at exactly the same pixel locations. Armor ends at the existing belt/hip and fits snugly around the actual shoulders and torso; do NOT paste a floating catalog breastplate onto the character. Paint foreshortening and connections correctly: scarf sits over collar, sleeves emerge naturally from armholes, raised arm exposes the side, extended arm occludes the chest correctly. Keep all 12 poses, including the raised fist and horizontal extended punch in bottom row. Preserve the painted chibi style, dark clean outlines and upper-left light. Background must remain perfectly flat saturated magenta #FF00FF for chroma-key import; no texture, gradients, glow, shadows, transparency checkerboards, floor, text or other objects. Armor: plain fitted silver iron cuirass with restrained bronze edge trim and brown side straps. Navy fabric remains visible under the armor. Clearly plain tier I. Keep exactly the original silhouette and joints.
